headline: Lixian Wang files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations for IGIL
sum: Lixian Wang has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE regarding a substantial acquisition in International Gemological Institute Limited (IGIL), triggering mandatory public disclosure requirements under the SEBI Takeover Code.
detail: Lixian Wang has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to NSE under the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is mandatory when a person acquires shares exceeding prescribed thresholds and must be accompanied by supporting documentation. The disclosure initiates the statutory framework for substantial acquisitions and may require publication of detailed acquisition information, regulatory approvals, and if applicable, an open offer to public shareholders.
